title: Morning, December 23

pages.message: Though small particles typically remain in the atmosphere for only a few days, they can be transported far away from source regions by large scale weather systems.

note: Ours (from nell-v2): the North China Plain in the winter of 2018-19, a stretch from clear air through smog building for days to a cold front sweeping it out, every hour of it.
